head_commit.message:
ci: judge this repository's dependency PRs, comments only (C-1) (#156)

* ci: judge this repository's dependency PRs, comments only

judge.yml (pull_request on package-lock.json, contents: read) builds the
judge from the base commit, reads the PR's package.json and lockfile as
data from its test merge commit, and records the judgement as an
artifact; the record is "undecidable" unless the judge finished.
judge-comment.yml (workflow_run, pull-requests: write + actions: read)
checks out and runs nothing, validates the artifact against the record's
schema, and keeps one comment per PR when the recorded head is the PR's
current head. Not a required check. Actions pinned by commit SHA.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci: #156 review round 1, refusal read by the head's SHA

judge-comment.yml decides the .github/ refusal from the compare API for
the run's own head SHA (contents: read), not the PR's current file list,
and refuses at 300 files. Tests pin the refusal. Also: the comment stays
under GitHub's limit once indented; a finished run with no record is an
error; a re-run overwrites the record; comma file names are undecidable;
SHA/time checks reject a final newline; head repository and branch must
match the run; more invisible characters are dropped; the wording says
"parts of gates 1, 2 and 4" and that 可 is not leave to apply.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci: #156 review round 2, base from the test merge commit

The event's base SHA is set when the PR opens and goes stale when the
base branch moves, so every later push was undecidable. The base is now
the test merge commit's first parent, checked to be on the base branch;
the judge is built from it and the before files and file list come from
it. Tests pin it. Also: SHA check needs 40 hex digits, PRs into other
branches are not commented, more invisible characters are dropped, and
the refusal notice names the 300-file case.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: #156 review round 2, and the first live judge run (#159)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: the second live judge run, after the base moved (#159)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
